      "observations": [
        "All three owned C++ hunks were read. nsLDAPURL, nsMsgMailNewsUrl and nsMailtoUrl gain SizeOfIncludingThis methods that ignore aMallocSizeOf and return zero. The nsMailtoUrl method is in historical nsSmtpUrl.cpp, not an nsSmtpUrl method.",
        "These are stub accounting hooks, not measurements that the objects or their owned buffers consume zero memory. The comments defer calculation until needed, with a calcaulte typo; they establish no new naming or comment-writing rule. No tests change.",
        "Accepted LDAP and mailnews implementations retain the zero return. Their current headers now separately declare nsIURIWithSizeOf, while original headers used nsIURI declarations. The interface move is a later phase, not evidence this original patch implemented that later interface contract.",
        "Historical nsSmtpUrl.cpp is absent at the accepted revision. Metadata identifies deletion in 7a37cdb1ad9d79c4253d8d31d2d1b0c4bca2e447, Remove nsISmtpUrl and nsIMailtoUrl XPCOM interfaces. Only that deletion metadata was inspected; no later replacement bodies, upstream caller, ABI or memory-reporting correctness is claimed. Own discussions remain pending.",
        "The full primary requests zero-return stubs for the new URI method. Later human replies report a 32-bit Windows calling-convention failure, propose changing the declaration to virtual size_t ... override and announce a Try push. Those upstream declarations and the resulting platform build remain unverified locators.",
        "D274977 approval is conditional on building with the upstream patch. The author reports a local build, confusion between the Try base and pushed commit, then a working run whose Windows failure is still discussed. Preserve those phases rather than calling approval a clean platform result.",
